image_description: A vintage green Olympia typewriter sits on a wooden desk. The image focuses on the keyboard area, specifically highlighting the long, white space bar at the bottom center of the key layout. To the left is a small glass inkwell, and in the background are framed pictures and a box of Ricoh paper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visually, the space bar is significantly wider than the round type keys above it, fitting the proportional description.

The refraction and reflection in the glass inkwell appear slightly unnatural and 'smudged', lacking crisp optical clarity.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific identification of the component as a space bar within the context of a typewriter.
To verify the physical separation of the space bar from the adjacent keyboard frame and ensure no melting/fusion artifacts.
To assess overall structural coherence and detect subtle geometric distortions in the typewriter mechanism.
To evaluate the severity of text artifacts in the background, which may indicate broader generation issues.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between the white space bar and the green typewriter body.
Geometric straightness and proportionality of the space bar relative to round keys.
Surface texture consistency of the space bar.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the boundary between the space bar and the chassis. AI often struggles with the precise mechanical tolerances of typewriters. Check for any 'bleeding' of the white key into the green body. Ignore background text gibberish unless it suggests structural collapse of the main subject.
